arrival.text: There's another machine over there, covered in dust. The scanner should be able to identify it.

scan.text: I'm InSight. I reached Mars in 2018 to study what lies beneath its surface.
I didn't need to drive around. I placed an instrument on the ground that could measure very small movements: a seismometer.
I recorded quakes that helped scientists understand what Mars is like inside.
While I worked, dust built up on my solar panels. With less sunlight reaching them, I produced less power.
My mission ended in 2022. The measurements I sent back stayed on Earth, ready for more research.

wrap_up.text: Done. I'll open the radar and keep going.

reaction.text: It discovered so much without going anywhere. I would never have noticed those tiny shakes.
